+'use strict';
+
+var es = require('../')
+  , it = require('it-is')
+
+exports ['filter'] = function (test) {
+  es.readArray([1, 2, 3, 4])
+    .pipe(es.filterSync(function(e) {
+      return e > 2
+    }))
+    .pipe(es.writeArray(function(error, array) {
+      test.deepEqual([3, 4], array)
+      test.end()
+    }))
+}
+
+require('./helper')(module)

+    }))
+    .pipe(es.writeArray(function(error, array) {

+      test.end()
+    }))
+}

+require('./helper')(module)
